comun.hecho: Made with the MindHaOS Exercise room

meta.titulo: What is exercise? The complete guide: principles, history and intensity | MindHaOS
meta.desc: How training works, its history, how much to move according to the WHO, how to measure your intensity (perceived exertion, reps in reserve and heart rate zones) and how to progress.

lista.resistenciaDet: Heart and lungs: walking, running, swimming, cycling.
lista.fuerzaDet: Muscles and bones: weights, bands or your own body weight.
lista.movilidadDet: Range of motion with control: hips, shoulders, spine.
lista.equilibrioDet: Stability and control: fewer falls, better form.
lista.resumen2: Measure your intensity (effort 1–10, reps in reserve, zones)
lista.resumen3: Progress little by little with a plan
lista.resumen4: Protect your recovery: sleep, protein and daily movement

dato.sobrecarga: Progressive overload: a little more than last time
dato.minutosModerados: minutes a week of moderate activity (or 75–150 vigorous)
dato.diasFuerza: days a week of strength, major muscle groups
dato.rir: reps in reserve at the end of the set
dato.progresion: maximum increase in weekly cardio volume
dato.sueno: of sleep per night for an adult
dato.proteina: of protein a day for people who train (ACSM)
dato.jahn: Jahn opens an outdoor gymnastics ground in Berlin
dato.morris: Morris: bus conductors, always on the move, had fewer heart attacks than drivers

pasos.especificidadDet: You adapt to what you practice.
pasos.constanciaDet: Use it or lose it: a little, often, is better.
pasos.repeticionesDet: 12 reps on every set, with good form.
pasos.cargaDet: More weight or more difficulty, then back to 8.
pasos.sobrecargaDet: A little more than last time.

grafica.historia: From the Greek gymnasium to science

rpe.pregunta: How do you feel right now?
rpe.n4: Light: you start to feel it
rpe.n5: Moderate: you can talk, not sing

zonas.formula: Tanaka estimate: 208 − 0.7 × age. It's approximate (±10 bpm).
zonas.z2Det: You breathe through your nose. Most of your cardio.
zonas.z5Det: Short efforts, a few seconds long.

plan.noCumpleOms: Below the WHO guideline: a good start, build up little by little

cierre.titulo: Keep your plan in your own house
cierre.texto: The MindHaOS Exercise room stores your workouts, times your sets and shows you every exercise with your character.

cita.texto: Eating well isn't enough to stay healthy: you also have to move.
cita.autor: Idea attributed to Hippocrates (5th century BC)

constancia.arriba: 2 hours on Monday… and nothing the rest of the month

griegos.arriba: Ancient Greeks: trained naked at the gymnasium

descarga.arriba: When they tell you deload week counts as training too
